description: Use when the traveller wants an itinerary or a day-by-day plan for a city. A ready plan: neighbourhoods per day, timed sights and meals (places locals eat), travel minutes, plus links to open and edit it in the planner, compare where to stay, and see where locals eat. Give the traveller the open_in_planner link.

city.description: City id or name from list_destinations, e.g. Tokyo, Paris, Seoul

days.description: Trip length; the nearest ready plan (2-4 days) is returned

lang.description: Language of names and notes (default en)

name: trip_plan
